players.product: 800G/1.6T optical transceivers + high-power ELSFP lasers (US-anchored manufacturing)

quarterly_data.signal: AAOI's 10-K states that its top ten customers represented 96.6%, 95% and 92.7% of revenue for 2025, 2024 and 2023, and that its top five customers represented 92.9% and 85.6% of revenue in 2024 and 2023.

AAOI's 10-K discloses a customer warrant issued on March 13, 2025 to a wholly-owned subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., whose remaining shares may vest over 10 years dependent on aggregate purchases by or on behalf of Amazon and its affiliates of $4 billion of AAOI's products. AAOI accounts for it as consideration to a customer, recognized as a reduction of revenue from Amazon as the related goods or services are transferred. The filing does not state which products Amazon buys.
quarterly_data.figure: $4 billion of aggregate Amazon purchases over 10 years (warrant vesting condition)
